title: 360 Apartment View
tagline: Immersive 360-degree virtual tours of apartments where you can upload and view a 360-degree virtual Apartment
description:
Finding apartment online is hard because they do not show all the view for the apartment. 

360ApartmentView help you view a 360-degree virtual tours of apartments.  Landlord  can upload a 360 image of the apartment for rent and pay for listing.  Listing is for 1 week and if they do not renew the listing, it will be hidden from the view.
how_its_made: I built the front end with react and use Chakra-UI for styling. I built the server with Node.js for storing apartment image on IPFS using Spheron Storage SDK. I built the contract with hardhat. I deploy my contract on Filecoin Testnet. I used Chainlink Automation to hide any apartment that did not renew.
